newsitem.title: USA: Respironics supplier move may hurt revs.
newsitem.headline: Respironics supplier move may hurt revs.

text.p: Respironics Inc said on Tuesday its sales for fiscal year ending June 1997 may be hurt from Apria Healthcare Group Inc's removal of the company as a "primary supplier" of Nasal CPAP and Bi-level systems.
The company was named a secondary supplier, effective November 1, 1996, Respironics said.
The extent of the effects on revenues is not known, but sales to Apria during the fiscal year ended June 30, 1996 were $20.5 million, or 16 percent of total sales.
Respironics said it will manage expense levels more aggressively and take other steps for the remainder of the fiscal year.
Apria's new primary suppliers do not have a contractual volume commitment under their agreement, Respironics said, noting that it will continue to compete for Apria's business.
Also, Respironics said its previously announced acquisition of LIFECARE International is still expected to close on October 21, 1996.
